thresholdProvenance.note: The 79 and 62 boundaries are inherited from incumbent prompt-instruction language (its escalation trigger named surviving Highs at confidence 70-78), not derived from any calibration measurement. Self-reported confidence resampled 8 points apart on byte-identical input, so a candidate at 78 versus 79 is inside the noise band. These gates buy demote-instead-of-drop and severity-asymmetric handling, not sharper discrimination. Revisit once harvested dispositions supply real ground truth.

observedIncumbentAnchors.note: Recorded, not mechanically enforced: the incumbent instructed the Validator to reserve confidence above this value on a disproved verdict for directly-verified claims.
